title: Kiki the little chameleon and her colours.
lines: A chameleon is a kind of little lizard, with a long curly tail and two big round eyes that can look in every direction.
And do you know what's very special about Kiki?
Not when she sits on a red chair, or on a green leaf.
Kiki changes colour when she feels something.
The sun was shining through the window.
Mummy gave her a big kiss and there were pancakes on the table.
And look: Kiki turned all yellow!
When Kiki is happy, she turns yellow.
Kiki went to school, to the nursery class.
And she went to play in the building corner.
She built a really tall tower of blocks.
One block, two blocks, three blocks, ten blocks high!
But then Max came, and Max pushed the tower over.
All the blocks fell on the floor.
Kiki felt something hot in her tummy.
She clenched her fists and she stamped her foot.
And look: Kiki turned all red!
When Kiki is angry, she turns red.
Kiki, said the teacher, I can see you're angry.
Breathe in deeply through your nose, and slowly out through your mouth.
And Kiki said to Max: I don't like that, Max.
Shall I help build a new tower?
And slowly Kiki went back to normal.
After playtime Kiki ran across the playground.
And suddenly she missed her mummy very much.
A tear rolled down her cheek.
When Kiki is sad, she turns blue.
The teacher sat down next to her.
She just gave Kiki a big hug.
Kiki already felt a little better.
In the afternoon the sky suddenly became very dark.
When Kiki is scared, she turns purple.
But the teacher said: I'm here.
The storm is outside, and we are inside.
Together they counted: one, two, three, four, five.
The thunder was already further away.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
And then the sun came back.
And do you know what was in the sky?
With all the colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
After school Mummy came to pick Kiki up.
Kiki climbed onto her lap and told her everything.
About the pancakes, the tower, the knee and the thunderstorm.
And while she talked, Kiki became calm.
When Kiki is calm, she turns green.
Mummy, asked Kiki, is it bad that I have so many colours?
Everyone has all those colours inside.
Happy, angry, sad, scared and calm.
When you talk about them, things always feel a little lighter.
And do you know what colour she turned then?
